latHint: Think thunder, lightning, and a downpour.
pivHint: To BREW is to make coffee - but trouble that is BREWing is like dark clouds before a ______.
winText: Dark clouds ahead. BREW was the pivot - hot coffee to a STORM that is BREWing.
lossText: STORM - violent wind and rain. BREW was the pivot: you BREW coffee, and a STORM is BREWing when trouble gathers.
